requirements.requirement: The system must define a typed frontend data contract object containing fields: phase_label, explanation_text, and score_contribution.
The system must constrain phase_label to accepted values: I, II, III, IV, or combined forms (e.g., I/II, II/III).
The system must define explanation_text as a markdown-compatible string suitable for rendering in MessageBubble.tsx.
The system must define score_contribution as a numeric or string field that can be rendered directly in the UI without additional transformation.
The system must ensure the data contract structure is compatible with the existing MessageBubble rendering pipeline input format.
The system must support rendering all valid phase_label values without requiring conditional UI branching outside the contract.
The system must allow explanation_text to include line breaks and basic markdown elements (bold, lists) supported by MessageBubble.
The system must define a fallback contract state where phase_label is 'Unknown' and explanation_text indicates unavailable data.
The system must define a fallback score_contribution value (e.g., null or 0) when backend data is missing.
The system must ensure the contract can be serialized into JSON without loss of required fields.
The system must ensure explanation_text is written in plain language understandable at or below an 8th-grade reading level.
The system must ensure explanation_text avoids clinical jargon unless accompanied by a brief definition.
The system must ensure explanation_text clearly communicates the purpose of the phase (e.g., safety vs efficacy testing).
The system must ensure explanation_text length does not exceed a predefined limit suitable for chat display (e.g., 300 characters).
The system must ensure the contract supports deterministic rendering (same input produces identical output structure).
The system must ensure explanation_text tone is neutral and non-promotional.
The system must ensure explanation_text does not make treatment recommendations.
The system must ensure explanation_text distinguishes early-phase trials from late-phase trials in terms of evidence maturity.
The system must ensure explanation_text avoids absolute claims (e.g., 'proven', 'guaranteed').
The system must ensure explanation_text is consistent for identical phase_label inputs across sessions.
